observations.subject: Combined population boundary is legible
observations.detail: The top views show 2749+2250 residents and a disabled acceptance action below the threshold, then 2750+2250 residents and the enabled government request at the exact 5000 threshold. The German invitation, grant and status copy fit and remain readable. These are the upper portions of an intentionally scrollable panel.

observations.subject: Third city offer and travel controls are fully shown by lower views
observations.detail: The new lower views show all three city progress rows with complete button rectangles and captions. Seven Hills has Auftrag ansehen before acceptance and Nach Seven Hills reisen after acceptance. Big Rock is correctly marked Du bist hier. Rockos portrait is visible below the travel rows. Content outside the scroll viewport is masked as expected; the new bottom views remove the previous missing-row evidence limitation.

observations.subject: Rockos actual figure route shows the government request
observations.detail: 03_rockos_third_city_government_request.png now visibly shows Rocko: Sieben Huegel brauchen uns, the dismissed mayor and Seven Heights background, the Seven Hills threshold notice and acceptance action in the campaign panel. It no longer shows Milas generic conversation.

observations.subject: Arrival and first building progression remain readable
observations.detail: Seven Hills HUD, resident count zero, town-hall focus and Rocko arrival portrait are clear. The garden and harvest previews have complete titles, objectives and action buttons. The first garden construction fence, countdown and inspector actions visibly communicate the running build. One lower inspector scroll-content line is masked above the fixed action buttons; the important construction state and controls are visible.

observations.subject: Initial hill abandonment is represented by modest props
observations.detail: The initial Quellhuegel has a small visible debris/wood pile, while its dominant stone terrace, railing, flowers and bench already look intact and cared for. This is a limitation of the authored visual stage rather than a new capture failure. A strong ruined-versus-restored landmark transformation is not established by this single initial view; final hill views are assigned to another reviewer.

observations.subject: Four districts and the city identity are coherent
observations.detail: Farm buildings and crop conveyors, the town hall and coffee area, large residential houses, and workshop buildings form four readable areas. Seven Hills signs and planted terrace landmarks provide its authored identity. Fixed HUD and navigation controls remain inside the images without text overlap. These explicitly grown fixture views show 108375 local residents and are visual coverage rather than natural economic progression evidence.

observations.subject: Mila chapter content and choice states are readable
observations.detail: Mila Morgen, the teacher/books role, chapter titles, fresh-delivery and park goals, biography and rewards fit the story detail panel. Both third-chapter choices are fully visible. The accepted state shows the chosen common meeting-place decision. No missing glyphs or clipped decision captions were observed in these German views.

observations.subject: Mila memories are now visible directly in the city
observations.detail: Both world memory views are free of reward and story overlays. Mila is centered on the open stone path with a book in her hands, feet visibly on the ground and an overhead story marker. The first completion has one small reading-corner object to her right; after the third-chapter meeting-place choice there are three visible authored memory objects arranged on the adjacent ground. They remain clear of the figure and fixed navigation dock.

observations.subject: Actual image inspection scope
observations.detail: All 24 current screenshot files at indices 0-23 were opened with view_image and emitted as original-resolution image pixels in four batches. This report covers those images only. It does not certify physical touchscreen behavior, every remaining screenshot, or user art acceptance.
